trigger.description: An agent records `ee outcome --pack <hash> --item <rank>` against a pack hash or id that has no persisted pack replay ledger in the selected workspace. This happens when the pack was assembled read-only/no-persist or when the agent copied a pack address from another workspace. The command fails honestly instead of guessing a memory id.

notes: The repair is to rerun `ee pack` without read-only/no-persist or pass the target memory id directly. The error protects item-addressed feedback from attaching to the wrong memory.
